from datetime import datetime, timezone
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.ml import PipelineModel

ET = ZoneInfo("America/New_York")

STORAGE_ACCOUNT = "stnvdaanna2026"

STREAM_ROOT = (
    f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/stream"
)

MODEL_PATH = (
    f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "models/nvda_volume_rf/"
)

PREDICTION_ROOT = (
    f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "prediction/streaming/"
)

print("STREAM_ROOT:", STREAM_ROOT)
print("MODEL_PATH:", MODEL_PATH)
print("PREDICTION_ROOT:", PREDICTION_ROOT)

yyyy, mm, dd = TEST_SESSION_DATE.split("-")

input_path = (
    f"{STREAM_ROOT}/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/tweets_gold.json"
)

print("Reading:", input_path)

raw_stream_df = (
    spark.read
    .option("multiline", "true")
    .json(input_path)
)

raw_stream_df.printSchema()

streaming_df = (
    raw_stream_df
    .select(
        F.explode("tweets").alias("tweet")
    )
    .select("tweet.*")
)

print("Tweet rows:", streaming_df.count())

streaming_df.printSchema()

display(streaming_df.limit(5))

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

stream_features_df = (
    streaming_df

    # candidate session -> actual prediction session
    # 2026-09-16 is a Wednesday / NYSE trading day,
    # so for this live test it remains 2026-09-16.
    .withColumn(
        "prediction_session_date",
        F.to_date("candidate_prediction_session_date")
    )

    # Same calendar features used during training
    .withColumn(
        "day_of_week",
        F.date_format("prediction_session_date", "EEEE")
    )

    .withColumn(
        "is_weekend",
        F.dayofweek("prediction_session_date").isin([1, 7])
    )

numeric_features = [
    "sentiment_score",
    "interaction_score",
    "favorite_ratio",
    "reply_ratio",
    "followers_count",
    "friends_count",
    "media_count",
    "account_age_days",
    "credibility_score"
]

boolean_features = [
    "is_viral",
    "is_blue_verified",
    "is_new_account",
    "is_influencer",
    "is_weekend"
]

for col_name in numeric_features:
    stream_features_df = stream_features_df.withColumn(
        col_name,
        F.coalesce(
            F.col(col_name).cast("double"),
            F.lit(0.0)
        )
    )

for col_name in boolean_features:
    stream_features_df = stream_features_df.withColumn(
        col_name,
        F.coalesce(
            F.col(col_name).cast("boolean"),
            F.lit(False)
        )

check_cols = (
    numeric_features
    + boolean_features
    + ["day_of_week"]
)

stream_features_df.select([
    F.sum(
        F.col(c).isNull().cast("int")
    ).alias(c)
    for c in check_cols
]).show(truncate=False)

from pyspark.ml import PipelineModel

print("Loading model:")
print(MODEL_PATH)

loaded_model = PipelineModel.load(MODEL_PATH)

print("Model loaded successfully.")

predictions_df = loaded_model.transform(
    stream_features_df
)

print("Prediction rows:", predictions_df.count())

display(
    predictions_df.select(
        "tweet_id",
        "prediction_session_date",
        "day_of_week",
        "sentiment_score",
        "interaction_score",
        "prediction"
    )

daily_prediction_df = (
    daily_prediction_df
    .withColumn(
        "prediction_generated_at_utc",
        F.current_timestamp()
    )
    .withColumn(
        "model_version",
        F.lit("nvda_volume_rf_v1")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "prediction_cutoff",
        F.lit("06:00 America/New_York")
    )
)

display(daily_prediction_df)

session_date = TEST_SESSION_DATE
yyyy, mm, dd = session_date.split("-")

prediction_output_path = (
    f"{PREDICTION_ROOT}"
    f"{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/"
)

print("Writing to:")
print(prediction_output_path)

(
    daily_prediction_df
    .write
    .mode("overwrite")
    .parquet(prediction_output_path)
)

print("Prediction written successfully.")

saved_prediction_df = spark.read.parquet(
    prediction_output_path
)

print("Saved rows:", saved_prediction_df.count())

display(saved_prediction_df)
